title: 회전형 S.W.I.M. (Rotary S.W.I.M.)
desc_src: Rotary S.W.I.M. (Sequential Wave Imprinting Machine) showing rotating magnetic field of a motor in polar stationary coordinates as part of a live lecture demonstration in a teaching auditorium lecture hall at University of Toronto Rotary SWIM, invented by S. Mann in the 1960s and 1970s, is commonly used in research and teaching, to see and photograph the rotating magnetic field of a motor. Here we see the three capabilities of SWIM: live display of text, graphics (plotted functions) and images such as the graticule and the "center" symbol image.
description_ko: 모터의 회전 자기장을 그래프와 파형으로 보여 주는 장치다. 텍스트, 그래픽, 이미지를 실시간으로 표시할 수 있다.
detail_text_ko: S. Mann이 1960~70년대에 고안한 회전형 S.W.I.M.은 모터의 회전 자기장을 극좌표 상에서 보여 주는 장치다. 연구와 교육에서 회전하는 자기장을 눈으로 보고 촬영하는 데 쓰인다. 사진은 토론토 대학교 강의실에서 열린 실시간 시연 장면으로, 눈금과 '중심' 기호 이미지가 함께 투영되고 있다.
notes: 교육·연구용 시연 장치 성격이 강해 작품 여부가 애매함. 작가 표기는 원문 기준.

title: Dülmen, Kirchspiel, Marienkapelle Visbeck, Turm -- 2022 -- 4157
desc_src: Weather vane on the tower of the St Mary’s Chapel in der Dernekamp hamlet, Kirchspiel, Dülmen , North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany The St Mary’s Chapel chapel is closely linked to the historic Visbeck manor. The estate itself was first mentioned in documents in 1186 as Villa Visbeck and developed into a fortified building on two islands in the Middle Ages. From 1338, it belonged to the Lords of Visbeck until the family died out in 1540 and the property changed hands several times. The earliest evidence of a chapel at this location dates back to 1572 – at that time, it was a wooden St. Mary’s Chapel that belonged to the castle complex. The brick chapel of St. Mary that stands today was built between 1747 and 1749 and is located some distance from the remains of the original castle complex. It is attributed to the Baroque architect Johann Conrad Schlaun. On May 29, 1747, the chapel was granted the privilege of holding Mass by Pope Benedict XIV, a legal act that established the building as a liturgical space. Originally, the chapel had an octagonal floor plan, a symbolic design element typical of Baroque chapels. The brick building rests on a surrounding base and is characterized by pilasters at the corners and rectangular windows. In 1889, a rectangular extension was added, which serves as a nave and extends the original octagonal structure.
notes: 교회 첨탑 장식형 풍향계 사진. 건물 부속 장식이며 작품으로서의 근거가 원문에 없음

title: Duisburg, Landschaftspark Duisburg-Nord, Hochofen 2 -- 2025 -- 7422
desc_src: Blast furnace 2 (at night) in the Landschaftspark Duisburg-Nord , Duisburg , North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany The light installation was put into operation as permanent lighting in December 1996. It was designed by British artist Jonathan Park. The three colors red, green and blue are reminiscent of the functions of the ironworks: fire and heat, gas and water. The Landschaftspark Duisburg-Nord (also known as “LaPaNo” or “LaPaDu” for short) is a landscape park covering around 180 hectares surrounding a disused steelworks in Duisburg-Meiderich. The former plant was founded in 1902 by August Thyssen as a “joint-stock company for metallurgical operations” to supply his Siemens-Martin steelworks in Bruckhausen and Styrum, and went into operation on May 16, 1903, with the firing up of blast furnace 1. In 1985, blast furnace 5 was shut down after just twelve years of operation due to overcapacity on the European steel market, making it the last remaining blast furnace. In the 1990s, the halls, buildings, and outdoor areas were redesigned according to plans by architects Peter Latz + Partner. In 1994, the park was opened to the public.

title: Infinity mirror, hand-washing sink and wardrobes in the spa of Amantaka luxury Resort & Hotel in Luang Prabang Laos
desc_src: Infinity mirror , hand-washing sink and wardrobes in the spa of Amantaka luxury resort and hotel in Luang Prabang , Laos . Amantaka is one of the 34 properties operated by Aman Resorts , hospitality company founded by Indonesian hotelier Adrian Zecha in 1988, present in more than 20 countries. The hotel, located in a French colonial building, opened in September 2009. A boutique hotel, it contains 24 lavish suites, encircling a central courtyard and is designed with a mixture of traditional Lao furnishings and modern. The suites range in size from 70 to 120 square metres and include eight suites, four pool suites, eight Khan pool suites, two Mekong pool suites and two Amantaka pool suites. All of the rooms have a king-sized bed centre of the suites beneath a traditional high ceiling. They are painted in white and have mahogany or dark wood furnishings and windows. The rooms are reported to be between 1,100 USD and 1,900 USD a night.

title: Building in historicist style in 10555 Berlin-Hansaviertel, Cuxhavener Straße 14
desc_src: Building in Berlin-Hansaviertel , in the style of historicism . 10555 Berlin, Cuxhavener Straße 14. One of the ca. 40 buildings of the locality (out of 343) which were not destroyed by bombings during the Second World War. 1942 this was probabely a "jews house", where jews, who were expelled from their apartments, were forced to live. [ 1 ] Today beyond others the residence of the embassy of the Republic of Honduras. In front of the building is placed the wind-kinetic sculpture ""Bar and disc", designed by Rolf Lieberknecht , erected in 1989, 10 m high, stainless steel.

title: The Marquess of Londonderry (Earl Vane) as a weather-vane
desc_src: The Marquess of Londonderry (Earl Vane) as a weather-vane; the north and south poles have been replaced by "radicalism" and "Toryism". Coloured lithograph by H.B. (John Doyle), 1843. The Marquess of Londonderry had a reputation for being a High Tory who used his influence to promote Tory interests in the election of members of Parliament. It was thus a surprise when a vacancy for an M.P. in the city of Durham in August 1843 was filled by the Radical and violent member of the Anti-Corn Law League, John Bright Iconographic Collections Keywords: John Doyle
notes: 풍자 석판화(정치 풍자 인쇄물). 작품 설치가 아님

desc_src: The artwork processes the text from all 37 of Shakespeare's plays, reorganizing the words and setting them in motion across 37 illuminated display panels, each dedicated to a different play. title: 카메라 페인팅 01 (camera painting 01)
desc_src: "Camera painting" photo -- experimental digital photography by Rick Doble. The technique known as "camera painting" creates an image by moving the camera across a light source for an extended period of time. It was taken handheld at about an 8 second exposure (see EXIF data below). The effect was created with photography and not with computer graphics.
description_ko: 카메라를 광원 위에서 움직이며 장시간 노출해 빛의 궤적으로 그린 실험적 사진이다. 파란 빛줄기가 소용돌이처럼 휘감겨 있다.
detail_text_ko: 작가 릭 도블(Rick Doble)의 '카메라 페인팅' 기법 사진이다. 원문에 따르면 카메라를 손에 든 채 약 8초간 노출해 빛을 붓질처럼 기록했으며, 컴퓨터 그래픽이 아닌 촬영만으로 만든 효과다. 움직임 자체가 화면의 형태를 결정하는 점이 감상 포인트다.
notes: 조각·설치가 아닌 사진 작품. 카메라 이동으로 만든 빛의 궤적(움직임 표현)을 근거로 통과. 촬영일은 원문에 없어 null.

The technique known as "camera painting" creates an image by moving the camera across a light source for an extended period of time. It was taken handheld at about an 8 second exposure (see EXIF data below). The effect was created with photography and not with computer graphics.
description_ko: 카메라를 광원 위에서 움직이며 장시간 노출해 빛의 궤적으로 그린 실험적 사진이다. 어두운 배경에 푸른 빛의 선들이 흩어져 있다.

title: Duisburg, Landschaftspark Duisburg-Nord, Winderhitzer -- 2025 -- 7436-8
desc_src: Cowper stoves (at night) in the Landschaftspark Duisburg-Nord , North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany The light installation was put into operation as permanent lighting in December 1996. It was designed by British artist Jonathan Park. The three colors red, green and blue are reminiscent of the functions of the ironworks: fire and heat, gas and water. The Landschaftspark Duisburg-Nord (also known as “LaPaNo” or “LaPaDu” for short) is a landscape park covering around 180 hectares surrounding a disused steelworks in Duisburg-Meiderich. The former plant was founded in 1902 by August Thyssen as a “joint-stock company for metallurgical operations” to supply his Siemens-Martin steelworks in Bruckhausen and Styrum, and went into operation on May 16, 1903, with the firing up of blast furnace 1. In 1985, blast furnace 5 was shut down after just twelve years of operation due to overcapacity on the European steel market, making it the last remaining blast furnace. In the 1990s, the halls, buildings, and outdoor areas were redesigned according to plans by architects Peter Latz + Partner. In 1994, the park was opened to the public.
notes: 독일 두이스부르크 란드샤프츠파크의 야간 건물 외관(열풍로 구조물)과 보라색 조명 사진. 움직이는 작품으로 식별되지 않는 건물 외관.

title: 켄들 밴드 (Kendall Band)
desc_src: A view of " Kendall Band ", a three-part musical sculpture created between 1986 and 1988 by Paul Matisse in Kendall/MIT station. Shown in the photo is the "Pythagoras" section of the work.
description_ko: 지하철 켄들/MIT역 승강장 천장에 매달린 막대들로 이루어진 음악 조각이다. 원문은 이 작품을 세 부분으로 된 음악 조각으로 소개한다.
detail_text_ko: 폴 마티스(Paul Matisse)가 1986년부터 1988년 사이 제작한 3부작 음악 조각 '켄들 밴드'의 '피타고라스' 부분을 찍은 사진이다. 사진 속 작품은 켄들/MIT역에 설치되어 있다. 원문에는 구동이나 발음 방식이 없어 움직임 여부는 확인하지 않았다.
notes: 사운드 조각으로 통과. 원문에 구동·발음 방식과 재료가 없어 materials_ko는 null, 움직임 여부는 확인 불가. 제작 기간 1986~1988 중 시작년도 기록.

title: Dülmen, Kirchspiel, Marienkapelle Visbeck, Turm -- 2022 -- 4170-4
desc_src: Tower of the St Mary’s Chapel (at sunrise) in der Dernekamp hamlet, Kirchspiel, Dülmen , North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany The St Mary’s Chapel chapel is closely linked to the historic Visbeck manor. The estate itself was first mentioned in documents in 1186 as Villa Visbeck and developed into a fortified building on two islands in the Middle Ages. From 1338, it belonged to the Lords of Visbeck until the family died out in 1540 and the property changed hands several times. The earliest evidence of a chapel at this location dates back to 1572 – at that time, it was a wooden St. Mary’s Chapel that belonged to the castle complex. The brick chapel of St. Mary that stands today was built between 1747 and 1749 and is located some distance from the remains of the original castle complex. It is attributed to the Baroque architect Johann Conrad Schlaun. On May 29, 1747, the chapel was granted the privilege of holding Mass by Pope Benedict XIV, a legal act that established the building as a liturgical space. Originally, the chapel had an octagonal floor plan, a symbolic design element typical of Baroque chapels. The brick building rests on a surrounding base and is characterized by pilasters at the corners and rectangular windows. In 1889, a rectangular extension was added, which serves as a nave and extends the original octagonal structure.

title: St. Francis Winery and Vineyard, Santa Rosa, California, USA (6710755353)
desc_src: St. Francis Winery and Vineyard, Santa Rosa, California, USA St. Francis Winery & Vineyards , located in the heart of Sonoma Valley, produces big, bold, full-bodied wines that deliver on flavor. Each wine is produced from 100% hand-picked Sonoma County fruit and is a direct expression of their winemaking philosophy of “maximum extraction, minimal intervention." History In 1971, Joe Martin, a San Francisco businessman and his wife Emma purchased the 100 acre Behler Ranch Vineyard in Sonoma Valley, located in the historic town of Kenwood. In 1979, after several years of growing and selling grapes to local wineries, the decision was made by Joe and partner Lloyd Canton to build their own winery. St. Francis Winery was established and christened after St. Francis of Assisi, in recognition of the Saint’s role as a protector of the natural world and as acknowledgement of the Franciscan order, believed to have been the first to bring European grape cultivation to the new world. The Tradition Continues In the Fall 1999 the construction of St. Francis’ new state of the art Winery facility was completed just in time for the 1999 harvest. The new Winery, with Hood Mountain as its picturesque backdrop is located on the Wild Oak Vineyard 1 mile west of the original Winery site in Sonoma Valley. Much care and thought was involved in the creation of this immaculate facility, allowing St. Francis winemaking team the luxury of expanding their winemaking capabilities. With the completion of St. Francis Visitors Center in 2001, the transformation was complete. This stunning mission style Visitors Center located at the entrance of the Wild Oak Vineyard, offers three separate tasting bars, a beautiful slate patio with panoramic views of the surrounding Wild Oak Vineyards, lavender dotted gardens and vistas of the Sonoma Valley.

desc_src: Design by Tonkin Liu. Burnley's Panopticon, 'Singing Ringing Tree', is a unique musical sculpture which overlooks Burnley from its position high above the town on Crown Point. Constructed from pipes of galvanised steel stacked in layers, this Panopticon takes the form of a tree bending to the winds and harnesses the energy of those winds to produce a low, tuneful song. title: Duisburg, Landschaftspark Duisburg-Nord, Hochofenstraße -- 2025 -- 7448-50
desc_src: Crane installation on the blast furnace road in the Landschaftspark Duisburg-Nord , North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany The light installation was put into operation as permanent lighting in December 1996. title: Dülmen, Dernekamp, Marienkapelle -- 2021 -- 4456
desc_src: Lady chapel in the Dernekamp hamlet, Kirchspiel, Dülmen , North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany The St Mary’s Chapel chapel is closely linked to the historic Visbeck manor. The estate itself was first mentioned in documents in 1186 as Villa Visbeck and developed into a fortified building on two islands in the Middle Ages. From 1338, it belonged to the Lords of Visbeck until the family died out in 1540 and the property changed hands several times. The earliest evidence of a chapel at this location dates back to 1572 – at that time, it was a wooden St. Mary’s Chapel that belonged to the castle complex. The brick chapel of St. Mary that stands today was built between 1747 and 1749 and is located some distance from the remains of the original castle complex. It is attributed to the Baroque architect Johann Conrad Schlaun. On May 29, 1747, the chapel was granted the privilege of holding Mass by Pope Benedict XIV, a legal act that established the building as a liturgical space. Originally, the chapel had an octagonal floor plan, a symbolic design element typical of Baroque chapels. The brick building rests on a surrounding base and is characterized by pilasters at the corners and rectangular windows. In 1889, a rectangular extension was added, which serves as a nave and extends the original octagonal structure.
notes: 성당 건물 외관 사진 — 작품 아님

desc_src: Tower of the St Mary’s Chapel (at sunrise) in der Dernekamp hamlet, Kirchspiel, Dülmen , North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany The St Mary’s Chapel chapel is closely linked to the historic Visbeck manor. The estate itself was first mentioned in documents in 1186 as Villa Visbeck and developed into a fortified building on two islands in the Middle Ages. From 1338, it belonged to the Lords of Visbeck until the family died out in 1540 and the property changed hands several times. The earliest evidence of a chapel at this location dates back to 1572 – at that time, it was a wooden St. Mary’s Chapel that belonged to the castle complex. The brick chapel of St. Mary that stands today was built between 1747 and 1749 and is located some distance from the remains of the original castle complex. It is attributed to the Baroque architect Johann Conrad Schlaun. On May 29, 1747, the chapel was granted the privilege of holding Mass by Pope Benedict XIV, a legal act that established the building as a liturgical space. Originally, the chapel had an octagonal floor plan, a symbolic design element typical of Baroque chapels. The brick building rests on a surrounding base and is characterized by pilasters at the corners and rectangular windows. In 1889, a rectangular extension was added, which serves as a nave and extends the original octagonal structure.

title: 진자 빛 그리기로 만든 형상 (A shape created using light painting)
desc_src: A shape created using light painting This photo has been taken by a homemade Blackburn pendulum by me. The concept has been very articulately explained by Paul Wainwright in the following youtube video Also visit his website
description_ko: 직접 제작한 블랙번 진자에 광원을 달아 빛의 궤적으로 형상을 기록한 사진이다. 진자의 움직임이 그대로 조형이 된다.
detail_text_ko: 블랙번 진자(Blackburn pendulum)를 직접 제작해 촬영한 빛 그리기(light painting) 사진이다. 진자가 흔들리며 남긴 빛의 궤적이 입체적인 형상을 만든다. 원리는 Paul Wainwright가 영상으로 설명한 개념을 따른 것으로 소개된다. 감상 포인트는 움직임이 시간 속에서 형태로 기록된다는 점이다.
notes: 작가 미확인 — 원문상 촬영자는 업로더이고 Paul Wainwright는 개념 설명자로만 나옴 / 촬영일(2018) 원문 미확인

title: Duisburg, Landschaftspark Duisburg-Nord, Verladebrücke -- 2023 -- 1585
desc_src: Loading bridge in the Landschaftspark Duisburg-Nord , Duisburg , North Rhine-Westphalia , Germany The light installation was put into operation as permanent lighting in December 1996. It was designed by British artist Jonathan Park. The three colors red, green and blue are reminiscent of the functions of the ironworks: fire and heat, gas and water. The Landschaftspark Duisburg-Nord (also known as “LaPaNo” or “LaPaDu” for short) is a landscape park covering around 180 hectares surrounding a disused steelworks in Duisburg-Meiderich. The former plant was founded in 1902 by August Thyssen as a “joint-stock company for metallurgical operations” to supply his Siemens-Martin steelworks in Bruckhausen and Styrum, and went into operation on May 16, 1903, with the firing up of blast furnace 1. In 1985, blast furnace 5 was shut down after just twelve years of operation due to overcapacity on the European steel market, making it the last remaining blast furnace. In the 1990s, the halls, buildings, and outdoor areas were redesigned according to plans by architects Peter Latz + Partner. In 1994, the park was opened to the public.

title: 노래하는 나무 (Singing Ringing Tree)
desc_src: Crown Point, Burnley. Design by Tonkin Liu. Burnley's Panopticon, 'Singing Ringing Tree', is a unique musical sculpture which overlooks Burnley from its position high above the town on Crown Point. Constructed from pipes of galvanised steel stacked in layers, this Panopticon takes the form of a tree bending to the winds and harnesses the energy of those winds to produce a low, tuneful song. In June 2007, Singing Ringing Tree was named winner of a National Award for architectural excellence by the Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA).
description_ko: 바람을 받아 낮고 선율 있는 소리를 내는 강철 파이프 조형물이다. 바람의 힘으로 소리가 나는 사운드 조각이다.
detail_text_ko: 영국 번리 크라운 포인트 고지대에 설치된 파노프티콘이다. 아연도금 강관을 층층이 쌓아 바람에 휘는 나무 형상으로 만들었으며, 바람 에너지로 낮은 소리를 낸다. 원문에 따르면 2007년 영국왕립건축가협회(RIBA)의 건축 우수상을 받았다.
notes: [4e 중복정리: 1645 와 같은 작품]

desc_src: Crown Point, Burnley Design by Tonkin Liu. Burnley's Panopticon, 'Singing Ringing Tree', is a unique musical sculpture which overlooks Burnley from its position high above the town on Crown Point. Constructed from pipes of galvanised steel stacked in layers, this Panopticon takes the form of a tree bending to the winds and harnesses the energy of those winds to produce a low, tuneful song. In June 2007, Singing Ringing Tree was named winner of a National Award for architectural excellence by the Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA).
description_ko: 바람을 받아 낮고 선율 있는 소리를 내는 강철 파이프 조형물이다. 바람의 힘으로 소리가 나는 사운드 조각이다.
detail_text_ko: 영국 번리 크라운 포인트 고지대에 설치된 파노프티콘이다. 아연도금 강관을 층층이 쌓아 바람에 휘는 나무 형상으로 만들었으며, 바람 에너지로 낮은 소리를 낸다. 원문에 따르면 2007년 영국왕립건축가협회(RIBA)의 건축 우수상을 받았다.

title: Gear experiments KiuKajam
desc_src: Educational opportunities differ greatly between richer and poorer countries. Some differences, such as better-equipped schools in rich countries, are obvious. Others are not. These two boys are enthusiastically learning how gears work. These boys had never had an opportunity to play with any such toy. This is one of many hands-on experiences offered at a "Discovery Day" in Kiu Kajam, a mountain town between Luang Prabang and Vientiane, Laos. The events are organized by Big Brother Mouse, a literacy project in Laos. At each event, students can try more than 30 activities that they've never done before: play number games, examine fossils, construct an arched bridge, and look at bacteria through a microscope.

title: 바람 놀이 (Windspiel)
desc_src: Sculpture, "'Windspiel " by Goetz Dorl , 1989, Fennpfuhlpark, Berlin-Fennpfuhl , Germany
description_ko: 베를린 펜프푸흐 공원에 설치된 바람 조각으로, 여러 겹의 은색 금속 날개가 기둥 위에 달려 있다.
detail_text_ko: 작가 괴츠 도를(Goetz Dorl)이 1989년 베를린 펜프푸흐 공원(Fennpfuhlpark)에 설치한 작품이다. 제목 '빈드슈필(Windspiel)'은 바람 놀이라는 뜻으로, 바람에 반응하는 조각임을 가리킨다. 나무와 벤치가 있는 공원 풍경 속에 세워져 있어 주변 자연과 어우러지는 점이 감상 포인트이다.

attribution: OTFW , Berlin / Self-photographed / CC BY-SA 3.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 바람 놀이 (Windspiel)
desc_src: Sculpture, "'Windspiel " by Goetz Dorl , 1989, Fennpfuhlpark, Berlin-Fennpfuhl , Germany
description_ko: 베를린 펜프푸흐 공원 바람 조각을 가까이서 찍은 사진으로, 은색 금속 날개가 겹겹이 달린 구조가 보인다.
detail_text_ko: 작가 괴츠 도를(Goetz Dorl)이 1989년 베를린 펜프푸흐 공원에 설치한 '바람 놀이' 작품이다. 이 사진은 1332와 같은 작품을 근접 촬영한 것으로, 겹쳐 달린 금속 날개와 기둥을 연결하는 축이 선명하게 보인다. 제목이 가리키듯 바람을 받아 반응하는 구조가 감상 포인트이다.
notes: 1332와 동일 작품 다른 사진(중복 후보) [4e 중복정리: 1332 와 같은 작품]

title: 퍼뮤테이셔널 구조물 (Structure Permutacional)
desc_src: Sculpture by Francisco Sobrino in the open-air museum Museo de Escultura al Aire Libre de la Castellana, Madrid/Spain
description_ko: 거울 면 금속 패널로 된 입방체 모듈이 엇갈려 배열된 조각이다.
detail_text_ko: 프란시스코 소브리노(Francisco Sobrino)의 작품으로, 원문에는 마드리드 야외 미술관에 설치된 것으로 적혀 있다. 사진에서는 움직임이 확인되지 않아 키네틱·옵아트 분류는 불확실하다. 반사되는 금속 면이 주변 나무와 건물을 비추는 점이 감상 포인트이다.
notes: 설치 장소(마드리드)와 사진 장소 일치 여부 확인 불가, 구동 미확인

attribution: Kinkreet / Own work / CC BY-SA 3.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 원조 오레리 (The Original Orrery)
desc_src: One of the earliest mechanical models of the solar system constructed. made by John Rowley in 1712.
description_ko: 1712년 존 롤리가 만든 초기 기계식 태양계 모형이다. 기계 장치로 행성의 운행을 재현하는 구조이다.
detail_text_ko: 존 롤리(John Rowley)가 1712년에 만든 오레리(orrery)로, 태양계를 기계적으로 재현한 초기 모형 중 하나로 소개된다. 가운데 태양 장식을 중심으로 행성이 도는 방식이며, 별무늬가 있는 원형 상판이 특징이다. 전시 사진에서는 작동 장면이 보이지 않아 움직임은 설명에 근거해 판단했다.
notes: 작동 장면 미확인, 기계식 모형으로 분류

attribution: Jeremy Thompson from Los Angeles, California / Chicago 106 / CC BY 2.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 사운딩 스컬프처 (Sounding Sculptures)
desc_src: In the Aon Center Plaza: "Sounding Sculptures" by Henry Bertoia
description_ko: 시카고 에온 센터 광장에 세워진 수많은 금속 막대 조각이다. 가늘고 긴 막대들이 빽빽하게 모여 벽처럼 보인다.
detail_text_ko: 헨리 베르토이아(Henry Bertoia)의 '사운딩 스컬프처' 작품으로, 시카고 에온 센터(Aon Center) 광장에 설치되어 있다. 이름처럼 소리를 내는 사운드 조각으로 소개되며, 사진에서는 막대들이 나무와 고층 건물 사이에서 빛을 받아 반짝이는 모습이 보인다. 원문에는 설치 위치만 기록되어 구동 방식은 확인되지 않는다.
photographer: Jeremy Thompson from Los Angeles, California

description_ko: 베를린에 설치된 기둥형 조각으로, 원문에서 바람과 빛의 놀이로 소개된다. 검은 금속 그릇 모양 상부에 구형 장식이 얹혀 있다.
detail_text_ko: 호르스트 K. 바우디슈(Horst K. Baudisch)가 베를린에 설치한 스텔레(Stele)형 조각으로, 원문에서 '바람과 빛의 놀이(wind and light play)'로 소개된다. 사진에서는 어두운 그릇 형태의 상부와 구형 장식이 보이며, 구동 장치는 확인되지 않는다. 작품 이름이 바람과 빛을 함께 언급하는 점이 감상 포인트이다.
notes: 구동부 미확인, 제작연도 미상(촬영일 2024 추정)

title: 바람 조각 (Windspiel)
desc_src: Sculpture Windspiel by Werner Richter in Berlin-Neu-Hohenschönhausen, Germany (Randowstraße/Vincent-van-Gogh-Straße).
description_ko: 베를린 노이-회엔쇤하우젠에 설치된 바람 조각으로, 검은 금속 판들이 기둥 끝에서 엇갈려 뒤틀린 형태를 이룬다.
detail_text_ko: 베르너 리히터(Werner Richter)의 '바람 조각(Windspiel)'으로, 베를린 노이-회엔쇤하우젠 란도브슈트라세와 반고흐슈트라세 인근에 있다. 날카롭게 꺾인 검은 금속 판들이 기둥 끝에서 엇갈려 있어, 바람에 반응하는 구조로 보인다. 설치 위치는 원문에 명시되어 있다.

title: 스카이블루스 (SkyBlues)
desc_src: "SkyBlues", a sculpture by Bill Culbert in Post Office Square, Wellington.
description_ko: 웰링턴 포스트오피스 스퀘어에 세워진 여러 개의 금속 기둥 조각이다. 기둥마다 나선형 와이어가 감겨 있다.
detail_text_ko: 빌 컬버트(Bill Culbert)의 '스카이블루스'로, 웰링턴 포스트오피스 스퀘어(Post Office Square)에 설치되어 있다. 길고 가는 금속 기둥들이 하늘을 향해 뻗어 있고 둘레에 나선형 와이어가 감겨 있다. 원문은 설치 장소만 밝히고 있어, 바람이나 빛에 따른 움직임은 사진으로 확인되지 않는다.
notes: 움직임 미확인 [4e 중복정리: 1708 와 같은 작품]

title: 바람 조각 (Windspiel)
desc_src: Wind chime by Matthias Frotscher in Zossener Straße in Berlin-Hellersdorf, Germany.
description_ko: 베를린 헬러스도르프 쫏세너 거리의 풍경형 바람 조각으로, 기둥 위에 프로펠러형 날개와 원반이 달려 있다.
detail_text_ko: 마티아스 프로트셔(Matthias Frotscher)의 바람 조각으로, 베를린 헬러스도르프 쫏세너 거리(Zossener Straße)에 설치되어 있다. 원문은 '풍경(wind chime)'으로 소개한다. 사진에서는 프로펠러형 날개, 원반, 붉은색과 흰색 장치가 기둥에 조합되어 있는 모습이 보인다.

title: 바람 조각 (Wind Sculpture)
desc_src: Wind Sculpture (Yinka Shonibare, 2014), Howick Place, London SW1
description_ko: 런던 하워드 플레이스에 설치된 바람 조각으로, 파란색과 노란색 격자 무늬가 펼쳐진 형태이다.
detail_text_ko: 야이카 쇼니바레(Yinka Shonibare)가 2014년 런던 하워드 플레이스(Howick Place)에 설치한 '바람 조각(Wind Sculpture)'이다. 원문에는 작가, 연도, 설치 장소만 기록되어 있다. 사진에서는 파랑과 노랑 격자 무늬의 천 같은 형태가 부풀어 솟아 있으며, 실제 움직임은 확인되지 않는다.
notes: 재질 미확인, 움직임 미확인

title: 그다음은 무엇 (Was, dann)
desc_src: Sculpture, " Was, dann " by Erich Wiesner , 1985, Otto-von-Simson-Straße 16, Berlin-Dahlem , Germany
description_ko: 베를린 달렘의 오토-폰-지몬-거리에 놓인 조각으로, 검은 금속 원반과 날개형 부재가 기둥 끝에 달려 있다.
detail_text_ko: 에리히 비스너(Erich Wiesner)가 1985년 베를린 달렘의 오토-폰-지몬-슈트라세 16번지 부근에 설치한 작품이다. 원문에는 제목이 '그다음은 무엇(Was, dann)'으로 적혀 있다. 사진에서는 검은 금속 원반과 날개형 부재가 기둥 끝에서 바람을 받는 듯한 구조로 보이며, 구동 방식은 원문에 기록되어 있지 않다.

title: USN Battleship Missouri Memorial illuminated in red, white and blue for 2008 Navy's Great White Gala - 080718-N-5476H-215
desc_src: The Battleship Missouri Memorial is illuminated in red, white and blue for the Navy's Great White Gala. 080718-N-5476H-215 PEARL HARBOR (July 18, 2008) The Battleship Missouri Memorial is illuminated in red, white and blue for the Navy's Great White Gala. The ceremony, which marked the centennial anniversary of the Great White Fleet's arrival to Hawaii, included a Theodore Roosevelt re-enactor, a pass and review by the guided-missile destroyer USS Chafee (DDG 90) and the guided-missile frigate USS Crommelin (FFG 37), and a fly-by of four F/A-18 Super Hornets from the aircraft carrier USS Kitty Hawk (CV 63). — Released (Text by U.S. Navy)
photographer: Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Michael Hight, USN

title: 키네틱 바람 조각 (Kinetisches Windspiel)
desc_src: Kinetic wind chime by Hein Sinken at the Kurt-Pfennig-Platz in Berlin-Tempelhof, Germany.
description_ko: 베를린 템펠호프 쿠르트-프페니히-광장에 설치된 키네틱 바람 조각이다. 검은 금속 곡면 날개가 기둥 끝에서 휘어져 있다.
detail_text_ko: 하인 진켄(Hein Sinken)의 키네틱 풍경(wind chime) 작품으로, 베를린 템펠호프 쿠르트-프페니히-광장(Kurt-Pfennig-Platz)에 있다. 원문은 바람에 반응하는 키네틱 조각으로 소개된다. 사진에서는 검은 금속 곡면 날개와 흰 원형 부분이 함께 보인다.

title: 프래자일 퓨처 III (Fragile Future III)
desc_src: With Fragile Future III, Studio Drift fuses nature and technology into a multidisciplinary light sculpture.
description_ko: 스튜디오 드리프트의 조명 조각으로, 빛나는 구체들이 금속 프레임에 촘촘히 달려 피라미드 같은 형태를 이룬다.
detail_text_ko: 스튜디오 드리프트(Studio Drift)의 '프래자일 퓨처 III(Fragile Future III)'로, 자연과 기술을 결합한 다분야 조명 조각으로 소개된다. 사진에서는 여러 개의 발광 구체가 금속 프레임에 모여 있으며 실내 바닥에 놓여 있다. 구동 방식은 원문에 나오지 않아 움직임 여부는 확인되지 않는다.
notes: 정적 조명 조각으로 보일 수 있음, 키네틱 판정 불확실

detail_text_ko: 원문은 Akuna St와 City Walk 교차로에 있는 Ernst Fries의 1981년작 ‘Wind Sculpture’라고 소개한다. 사진에는 격자 프레임에 은빛 패널이 다수 달려 있는 모습이 보이며, 바람에 반응하는 구조로 짐작된다. 다만 움직임은 사진으로 확인되지 않는다.

attribution: Photo: Mario del Curto, Automaton: François Junod / http://www.watch-around.com/uploads/media/Technique-pouch-011-e.pdf / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 알렉산드르 푸시킨 오토마타 (Alexander Pushkin automaton)
desc_src: Completed in 2010 by François Junod and his team, the automaton of Alexander Pushkin is capable of writing 1,458 different poems randomly accompanied by a matching drawing. The first mechanical android in history to do that.
description_ko: François Junod와 팀이 2010년에 완성한 푸시킨 모습의 오토마타다. 책상 앞에 앉아 펜을 들고 시를 쓰는 동작을 한다.
detail_text_ko: 원문에 따르면 이 오토마타는 1,458편의 서로 다른 시를 쓸 수 있고, 무작위로 그에 맞는 그림을 함께 그린다. 역사상 최초로 그런 일을 하는 기계 인간으로 소개된다. 사진에서 책상에 앉은 인형이 펜을 든 모습이 확인된다.
photographer: Photo: Mario del Curto, Automaton: François Junod

title: 음악 오토마타 (Musical automaton)

materials: 금도금 청동, 채색 청동, 유화, 유리 페이스트, 자개, 유리
description_ko: 런던에서 제작된 18세기 음악 오토마타로, 코끼리 형상과 금빛 장식이 유리 상자 안에 전시되어 있다.
detail_text_ko: 원문 표기에 따르면 Hubert Martinet가 런던에서 1768~1772년 사이에 만든 작품이며, 영국 Waddesdon Manor에 소장되어 있다. 사진에는 금빛 장식과 코끼리 조형, 유리 상자가 보인다. 작동 장면과 소리는 사진에서 확인되지 않아 움직임 여부는 단정하지 않는다.
notes: 작동 여부 미확인, created_year는 원문 제목 표기 범위(1768~1772)의 시작 연도

title: Worlds Largest Menorah
desc_src: Danny Danon, Israel's Ambassador to the UN, lit the one of the candles on the world’s largest Hanukkah menorah in New York City on December 29, 2016, the sixth night of the eight-day holiday. The 36 foot, 4,000 pound menorah organized by Chabad-Lubavitch, was certified by Guinness World Records as the largest in the world. The nightly Hanukkah celebration has taken place at Fifth Avenue and Fifty-Ninth Street since 1977. The annual event is part of a worldwide Hanukkah campaign to raise awareness and observance of the Jewish festival, set into motion by the Lubavitcher Rebbe, Rabbi Menachem M. Schneerson, of righteous memory, in 1973 Credit: Chaim Perl / Chabad.org This photograph is being made available only for publication by news organizations for use in reporting on the events captured in the photo. title: 기계식 플라네타륨 (Planetarium)
desc_src: Camera location 42° 22′ 35.43″ N, 71° 06′ 57.87″ W View this and other nearby images on: OpenStreetMap 42.376507; -71.116074 A mechanical planetarium made by Benjamin Martin in London in 1766, used by John Winthrop to teach astronomy at Harvard, on display at the Putnam Gallery in the Harvard Science Center
description_ko: 1766년 런던에서 Benjamin Martin이 만든 기계식 태양계 모형이다. 손잡이를 돌려 행성 모형들을 움직이는 구조다.
detail_text_ko: 원문은 하버드대 과학센터 Putnam Gallery에 전시된 기계식 플라네타륨이며, 존 윈스롭(John Winthrop)이 천문학 교육에 사용했다고 소개한다. 사진에는 받침 위 원판과 구체가 달린 팔들, 그리고 손잡이가 보인다. 키네틱 아트라기보다 과학 교구에 가까워 분류는 애매하다.
notes: 과학 교구 성격이라 분류 애매, 통과 판단은 손잡이 구동 기계 구조 기준

title: New building of the Metavers Museum
desc_src: The Metaverse Museum is a project born in Second Life for the enrichment of the artistic heritage created in virtual worlds. It was founded in September 2007 by Rosanna Galvani. In 2010 the museum moved to OpenSim in the Grid Craft. Since October 2014, the Metaverse Museum is located in two islands / simulators of the Grid Craft. The island MdM, houses the permanent collection of the museum and several temporary exhibitions. The simulator Uqbar was designed to be a recreational and welcoming area for museum visitors, but it has been enriched with cultural and artistic contents, thanks to the collaboration with László Ördögh Diabolus alias Velazquez Bonetto, founder of the Cybernetic Art Research Project (CARP). He has designed and constructed the new building as well.

title: Museo del Metaverso Old Building
desc_src: The Metaverse Museum is a project born in Second Life for the enrichment of the artistic heritage created in virtual worlds. It was founded in September 2007 by Rosanna Galvani. The first building of the Museum was designed and created by Elif Ayiter aka Alpha Auer. In 2010 the museum moved to OpenSim in the Grid Craft. Since October 2014, the Metaverse Museum is located in two islands / simulators of the Grid Craft. The island MdM, houses the permanent collection of the museum and several temporary exhibitions. The simulator Uqbar was designed to be a recreational and welcoming area for museum visitors, but it has been enriched with cultural and artistic contents, thanks to the collaboration with László Ördögh Diabolus alias Velazquez Bonetto who designed and built a second new building.

title: Influence of a father's artwork on the drawings of his children
desc_src: This photo shows the drawings of young Lao girls inspired by the artwork of their father-in-law. The painting on the right is an acrylic work on canva produced in 2006 by French artist Basile Morin , while the marker and pencil drawings on the left are imitations by the adopted daughters who found their inspiration in their father-in-law's paintings. With similar style, shapes and structures, these personal productions show the influence of a parent on young children in the artistic field. The two flags on each side of the colorful wheel are supposed to be Lao flags .

title: The Wrath of Neptune
desc_src: In Roman mythology, Neptune (or Poseidon in Greek mythology) is the god of flowing water and is believed to protect against droughts. This small bronze is likely a sculptural representation of the Wrath of Neptune from the Aeneid. During the Trojan War, Juno incited winds to sink Trojan ships. Infuriated by Juno's incursion into his domain of the sea, Neptune rides out in his chariot, saving the Trojan army and threatening to punish the winds for their insolence. The massive, muscular nude male figure stands upright on his seahorse-drawn chariot, twisting to face the wind. The turbulent waves and the windblown hair and beard of the figure give life to this small bronze. The figure's left hand would have originally held reins, while the right hand, which once held a trident, is outstretched in the act of commanding the waves to be still. This bronze was once attributed by art historian Wilhelm von Bode to Jacopo Sansovino based on its similarity to known works, such as the over-life-size marble figure of Neptune of the Scala di Giganti outside of the Doge's Palace in Venice. However, by 1921 Leo Planiscig had noted the CMA Neptune's similarity to bronzes and reliefs by Sansovino's pupil, Tiziano Minio, in the Loggetta at San Marco Square, Venice. In Minio's Jupiter on the Island of Candia for the Loggetta, the waves are represented with the same incised, undulating grooves as in this work. Neptune possesses the same stocky proportions and heavy musculature which was characteristic of Minio. The high polish and sweeping contours of the figure are characteristic of Sansovino, but the heightened drama of the subject display Minio's stylistic advancement from his teacher.

title: Sweets Bowl with Egrets and Willow in Snow
materials_raw: Porcelain with underglaze blue and iron oxide
desc_src:
For this sweets bowl, Yohei III designed a dramatic surround of egrets in a willow tree under heavy snow. The entire design is painted in cobalt blue under the transparent glaze. If one turns the bowl clockwise, two egrets come into view, one after the other. As they ascend, both struggle against the wind amid snow-laden weeping willow branches. They are followed by a stretch of willow branches that evoke the bitter cold. The sky is painted with blue washes all around the designs. The imagery culminates in a group of three egrets huddled together in the crotch of the tree. Of course, it is also possible to read the scene in the other direction, in which case the sheltering egrets look toward one of the flying egrets, who looks back at them, and it is the egret with wings outspread, looking directly down, who concludes the scene.

Two thin bands of blue set off the design just under the bowl’s rim, and a band of brown iron oxide runs along the rim. Another two bands of blue run around the middle of the foot. The inside of the bowl’s box lid has an attestation by Yohei IV that it is the work of Yohei III.
materials: Porcelain with underglaze blue and iron oxide
notes: 도자기 그릇 — 공예품

attribution: Pvrellis / Own work / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: Knit 1
desc_src: Circular loom The loom is an 28’’ aluminum rim, with 200 anchor pegs on its circumference. Knitting pattern In contrast to conventional knitting, absolutely no knitting is done inside the area of the loom. Instead, the thread is knitted as straight lines across the anchor pegs on the circumference, only. In geometric terms, the thread follows a path of consecutive circle’s chords. Thus, one single thread runs from one anchor peg to another, continuously, for 3.000 - 4.000 times, reaching a total length of 1 - 2 kilometers. Knitting is done by hand, with step-by-step instructions dictated by a computer. The absence of black thread gives a completely white color tone. The tone darkens as the density and the intersections of the black thread increase. Thus, a full grayscale palette (from black to white) is possible. Colored artwork is created from a limited palette of basic colors as black, blue, magenta, yellow and green. The combination of these basic colors can effectively produce a full color palette. The knit is transparent and can be viewed from both sides. Pattern generation The pattern is generated from a specially designed algorithm, coded in openframeworks ( http://openframeworks.cc/ ). The algorithm takes as input a digital photograph and outputs the knitting pattern. Over 2 billion calculations are needed to produce each pattern; not much of a load for today’s computers, but definitely an impossible task for the human brain. So, this is a new and unique type of knitting that could not have been implemented a few decades ago, without computers. Theme and aesthetics Although any digital picture can be converted to a knitting pattern of this type, portraits are the most interesting themes. Despite the extreme limitations of the design, the depicted faces are still recognizable, but inevitably appear fuzzy and smudged; a large degree of uncertainty about the characteristics and the emotions of the depicted persons is inducted. The first series of knitted portraits is based on El Greco’s expressive figures. Statement How is it possible to produce a complex portrait from such a limited design? Is our surrounding world “tricking” us the same way? As science evolves, new tools and experiments prove that our world is far more complicated, compared to what we think it is; our senses provide a very thin portion of reality. So, our brains are full of misconceptions and false ideas; our experience of the world is incorrect and incomplete. The project challenges our poor perception of reality and serves as a comment to our limited understanding of the world. Furthermore, it’s hard not to make physical and metaphorical connections to the mythological entities of Moirai (Fates) that controlled the thread of life of every mortal being, from birth to death; human life defined by a complex path of threads...

title: 스피로그래프 라이트 페인팅 (Spirograph light painting)
desc_src: This image captures a dynamic spirograph pattern rendered through light painting, using a red LED as the sole light source. Executed with a Canon EOS 800D at a 30-second exposure, the photograph visualizes hypotrochoid curve traced in midair. The rotational motion and geometric precision reflect the interplay between mathematical order and organic adaptation, offering a visual metaphor for cyclical processes in nature.

attribution: Pedro Ribeiro Simões from Lisboa, Portugal / Composition (1963) - Gunther Uecker (1936 / CC BY 2.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 구성 (1963) (Composition (1963))
desc_src: Belem, Berardo Collection, Centro Cultural de Belem, Lisbon, Portugal Material : Painted nails on wood BIOGRAPHY From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Günther Uecker, also known as Guenther Uecker, (born 13 March 1930) is a German sculptor, op artist and installation artist. Uecker was born in Wendorf, Mecklenburg. Uecker began his artistic education in 1949 when he took up studies at Wismar. He then went to the art school in Berlin-Weißensee and in 1955 to Düsseldorf, where he studied under Otto Pankok at the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf. In 1956 he began using nails in his art. Uecker met the group ZERO with Heinz Mack and Otto Piene in 1960, artists who propagated a new beginning of art in opposition to the German Informel. He occupied himself with the medium of light, studied optical phenomena, series of structures and the realms of oscillation that actively integrate the viewer and enable him to influence the visual process by kinetic or manual interference. Uecker, Mack and Piene began working together in joint studios at the Stedelijk Museum in Amsterdam in 1962 and installed a 'Salon de Lumière' at the Palais des Beaux-Arts in Paris. Other 'light salons' followed in Krefeld and in Frankfurt. Since 1966, after the group ZERO dissolved and a last joint exhibition, Uecker increasingly used nails as an artistic means of expression—a material that, until today, stands in the centre of his oeuvre. At the beginning of the 1960s he began hammering nails into pieces of furniture, musical instruments and household objects, and then he began combining nails with the theme of light, creating his series of light nails and kinetic nails and other works. Light and electricity continued to be one of the main subjects and natural materials such as sand and water were included in his installations, resulting in an interaction of the different elements to create a sensation of light, space, movement and time. Uecker's oeuvre includes painting, object art, installations as well as stage designs and films. His origins explain his interest in the eastern European avant-garde of the 1920s and 1930s, but he is likewise interested in Asian cultures and their ideas. His works can be seen in collections and large fairs in the West as well as the East. Uecker's artistic creativity reaches a climax in 2000 in the prayer room he designs for the rebuilt Reichstag building in Berlin. Uecker taught from 1974 until 1995 at the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf and was promoted to professor in 1976. Halina Jaworski was his first master student (Meisterschülerin). With Otto Piene, Heinz Mack and Mattijs Visser he founded in 2008 the international ZERO foundation. The foundation has the complete ZERO archives from three Düsseldorfer artists as well as documents and photos from other related artist. EXHIBITIONS In addition to numerous Gruppo Zero exhibitions, Uecker has participated in many other exhibitions, including documenta 4, Kassel, Germany (1968), the Venice Biennale (1970), and numerous solos shows, including one at the Kunsthalle Düsseldorf (1983), a retrospective at the Kunsthalle der Hypo-Kulturstiftung, Munich (1990), and another solo show at the Ulmer Museum, Ulm, Germany (2010). He had his first solo exhibition in the United States at the Howard Wise Gallery on West 57th Street, showing important work such as the kinetic New York Dancer I (1966). He designed the scenery for Richard Wagner's Lohengrin at Bayreuth (1979–82). COLLECTIONS Uecker's work can be found in the collections of major institutions worldwide, among them: the ZERO foundation and Museum Kunst Palast, Düsseldorf; Calderara Foundation Collection, Milan; Courtauld Institute of Art, (London); Honolulu Museum of Art, the Schleswig-Holstein Museums (Germany), Studio Esseci (Padua, Italy), Stedelijk Museum, Amsterdam, Van Abbemuseum (Eindhoven, Netherlands), Von der Heydt-Museum (Wuppertal, Germany); Museum of Modern Art, New York; Art Institute of Chicago, Chicago; Museum of Contemporary Art, Los Angeles; Centre Pompidou, Paris; Peggy Guggenheim Collection, Venice; and the Walker Art Center, Minnesota.

title: Blood Relations
desc_src: The original sculpture - co-created with Salman Rushdie - featured visceral waxy innards. Here the effect has been recreated using cherries, spice and also a sneaky spot of "post production". The outside of the sculpture relates to One Thousand and One Nights - an early form of Desperate Housewives. Even ABC executives have fallen under the writer's evil hegemony - if they ever try to axe the show, they know that they will never find out what happened next... These images are snapshots of results of a Fabrica / Brighton Festival Project volunteer's Party Game. Participants were invited to create sculptures (over a very short period of time) based on - or inspired by - the works of Anish Kapoor. The materials provided include foil, foam block, mirrors, spice, wheat flour, tape, glacé cherries, cocktail sticks, sticky tape...

description_ko: 1764년 프리드리히 폰 크나우스가 만든 오토마타로, 손이 글씨를 쓰는 기계 장치다.
detail_text_ko: 원문은 이 작품이 1764년 프리드리히 폰 크나우스가 만든 오토마타이며 갈릴레오 박물관(Museo Galileo)에 전시되었다고 설명한다. 이미지에는 은빛 금속 장식이 감싼 상자 위에 종이와 손 모양 장식이 놓여 있다. 명판에는 이탈리아어 제목 'La mano che scrive'와 1764년 제작 연도가 표기되어 있다.
notes: hint_artist 'Friedrich'는 불완전해 desc_src의 'Friedrich von Knaus' 기준. hint_year 2025는 촬영일 추정이라 미사용, 제작연도 1764는 원문 확인값. 재료는 원문 미확인이라 null.

attribution: Robert Ashworth from Bellingham, WA., USA / LEDs light up the holidays / CC BY 2.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: LEDs light up the holidays (31468924060)
desc_src: A while ago in my Facebook feed there was a nostalgia piece about remember when your parents drove you around to look at Christmas lights and how exciting it was. I wrote in a comment: More like I remember squinting through some fogged up windows in the backseat of my parents car trying to look at lights. These days I ride my bicycle around beautifully lit up neighborhoods at Christmas time. Today's LED lights allow me to bike longer at night on a battery. They also make for some fantastic displays on the houses. I have some nostalgia for my childhood Christmases, but the lights on houses seem even brighter today. Back then, it was all incandescent bulbs with the tiny twinkle ones just starting to come out. Today, it's lots of LEDs and even lasers. All, probably, from less energy consumption.

attribution: Zach Dischner / Stars and Orbs / CC BY 2.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: Stars and Orbs (9720481020)
desc_src: So driving back from Crested Butte a week or so from a weekend of mountain biking, I FINALLY got an opportunaty to shoot the Milky Way. Just happened to look out the window while driving through South Park, CO, and though "Holy snap, I can actually see the thing". I've been trying to get an chance to shoot this galaxy we live in (well, more just hoping a chance falls into my lap) for about a year. Between busy work schedules and some bad luck with weather I haven't shot it with my newer 5D Mark ii yet. So alas! A stroke of good luck put me right at a scenic pull out just as the rain clouds disappeared. Got the usual shots (which I'll probably post sometime) of the bikes and truck, but this one has to be my favorite. Had no light painting materials except for my headlamp. So I was surprised anything turned out. As always, I looked pretty goof-tastic, running around in flip flops through the pitch black grasses, only to stop and do the most spectacularly awkward interpretive dance trying to get an orb with the light. This one for some reason flared nicely, mid streak. No PP effect. Couldn't replicate it afterwards. What luck! More Places to find me: Zach Dischner Photography | 500px Blog: 2manventure

title: Great Pagoda, Great Bull, Front View, Tanjore, India (Rajarajeshvara Temple), plate 12 from Photographic Views of Tanjore and Trivady (Madras: Madras Presidency)
materials_raw: salted paper print from calotype negative
desc_src:
In a pillared pavilion called a mandapa, a colossal stone sculpture of Nandi, the mount of the Hindu god Shiva, faces the doorway to the main temple sanctum. The inner wall and section of the great gateway leading into the sacred site can be seen in the background of Tripe’s photograph.

As an active Indian temple, the plinth, or base, of the pavilion is painted with alternating red and white stripes. Tripe, however, opted not to include any living presence in the image, since humans and animals might move and create a blur, spoiling his clear photographic record of the monument.
materials: salted paper print from calotype negative

title: Stag at Sharkey's
desc_src: Bellows was no stranger to Sharkey’s Athletic Club, a raucous saloon with a backroom boxing ring, located near his studio. Founded by Tom “Sailor” Sharkey, an ex-fighter who had also served in the US Navy, the club attracted men seeking to watch or participate in matches. Because public boxing was illegal in New York at the time, a private event had to be arranged in order for a bout to take place. Participation was usually limited to members of a particular club, but whenever an outsider competed, he was given temporary membership and known as a “stag.” Although boxing had its share of detractors who considered it uncouth at best or barbaric at worst, its proponents—among them President Theodore Roosevelt—regarded it a healthy manifestation of manliness. Around the time Bellows painted Stag at Sharkey’s, boxing was moving from a predominantly working-class enterprise to one with greater genteel appeal. For some contemporaries, boxing was a powerful analogy for the notion that only the strongest and fittest would flourish in modern society.

attribution: R. Gopakumar / Own work / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: Cognition Libido
desc_src: In this thought-provoking artwork, the artist delves into the complex and universal phenomenon of inherent sexual desire that transcends gender boundaries. By exploring the intersection of human sexuality, spirituality, and psychology, the artwork seeks to expose and examine the primal and innate nature of this fundamental aspect of human existence. Drawing inspiration from diverse sources, the artist incorporates elements from various disciplines to enrich the artwork's narrative. The symbol of the Heart Chakra in Yoga, with its profound connection to emotions and love, serves as a visual representation of the underlying energy and intensity of sexual desire. Vibrant colors borrowed from Indian Tantric Art further enhance the artwork, evoking a sense of vitality, passion, and sensuality. In addition, the artist references the philosophical term "Libido" coined by Sigmund Freud, which explores the psychosexual energy that drives human behavior. By incorporating this concept, the artwork invites viewers to contemplate the interplay between biology, psychology, and desire, offering a multifaceted exploration of the complexities of human sexuality. This work of art serves as a provocative and introspective exploration of the universal nature of sexual desire, challenging societal norms and inviting contemplation on the powerful force that drives the creation of life. Exhibited and Collected: The Kinsey Institute Art Gallery, USA; ISE Cultural Foundation NY, USA.

title: Card Table
materials_raw: mahogany with curly maple and ebony veneers, brass mounts and inlays, gilding
desc_src: The lyre-shaped support of this finely made card table marks it as an example of American Federal furniture taking inspiration from classical antiquity for its decoration. When the top was folded closed, such tables were usually placed near a wall. Once the two halves of the top were unfolded, however, the entire upper portion of the table could be rotated until the supporting structure was again beneath the center and the enlarged surface was ready for play. The table was probably made by Michael Bouvier, a French cabinetmaker who worked in Philadelphia and was the first paternal American ancestor of Jacqueline Bouvier Kennedy Onassis.
materials: mahogany with curly maple and ebony veneers, brass mounts and inlays, gilding

title: Satyress
desc_src: In antiquity, satyrs were lustful woodland deities who delighted in wine and revelry. Renaissance artists adopted them as symbols of vice and carnal love; the female satyr, or satyress, on this bronze plaquette, recently reattributed from Riccio to Mosca, was probably derived from a copper engraving of a Roman sarcophagus by Marcantonio Raimondi (c. 1470/82-1527/34). Both the sarcophagus and subsequent engraving depicted a bacchanalia, or scene of orgiastic carousal; the peculiar objects surrounding the satyress have been added by the artist, possibly in an effort to remove the figure from her lewd original composition and give a more refined meaning. The satyress rests her right hoof upon a plumed helmet. A coiled shape, possibly a snake, winds out of the helmet. To her left, a laurel tree stands with only half of its branches in bloom. Two severed animal legs are tied around its trunk and an illegible plaque hangs from one of its branches. A lyre, a pan pipe, an animal jawbone and a bow are gathered at the base of the tree. The highly allegorical nature of the work uses obscure symbols, rather than a distinct narrative, to convey meaning and could possibly be read as an allegory of physical pleasure overcoming virtue.

title: 낚시 간 풍향계 (Gone fishing)
desc_src: Gone fishing. Weather vane on the gable end of a garage in Back Lane. Martham has always been a large and busy village with (presently) a post office, a couple of pubs, a supermarket and a variety of other shops, doctors surgery, pharmacy and more than 30 businesses, three schools, a public library, a large playing field with skate park and multi games area and two duck ponds. In 1300 CE the village had a population of about 1,000, and during the Middle Ages Martham provided the monks in Norwich with wheat, barley and peat. C19 directories list a great number of farmers, fishermen, craftsmen and tradesmen such as grocers, butchers, tailers, drapers, shoemakers, basket makers, wheelwrights, joiners, blacksmiths, millers, brick makers, bricklayers, thatchers, glaziers, wherrymen and watchmakers. Most of the bricks seen in older houses were made locally and are of similar appearance, texture and colour. The village green > 853060 is surrounded by C18 houses, some thatched; a fair and general marked used to be held here on the last Tuesday and Wednesday of July. http://www.martham.gov.uk/
description_ko: 낚시하는 사람과 우산이 오려진 금속 풍향계로, 바람에 따라 회전한다.
detail_text_ko: 영국 마텀 마을의 차고 박공 위에 달린 풍향계다. 낚시하는 사람과 우산이 녹색으로 칠한 금속판에서 오려져 있으며, 바람을 받아 방향을 가리키는 구조다. 제작자와 제작 연도는 원문에 없다.

title: 픽미 — HeK 바젤의 게시물 발신지로 비행 (Pic-Me – Fly to the Locations Where Users Send Posts)
desc_src: With Pic-me you can virtually fly to the locations from where users send randomly selected posts to Instagram, thus creating another view on how the media handles posts on social networks. One might describe these posts – images or short videos accompanied by comments, tags and geolocalization – as a kind of digital small talk or personal conversation. Different than face to face conversations, these fleeting thoughts are accumulated and archived by governments, corporations, and research institutes and then transformed into everlasting stories as well. We can’t tell yet, what the consequences of archiving these often personal and emotional posts are in the long run. The work by Marc Lee makes us think about the properties of the digital realm and what happens to the data that is generated by people all over the globe. http://marclee.io/en/pic-me-fly-to-the-locations-where-users-send-posts/
description_ko: SNS 게시물을 올린 위치로 가상 비행하는 영상 설치 작품이다.
detail_text_ko: 원문에 따르면 무작위로 고른 인스타그램 게시물의 발신 위치로 가상 비행하며, 이미지·짧은 영상·댓글과 위치 정보가 함께 표시된다. 작품은 SNS 대화의 기록과 보관 문제를 다룬다. 바젤 HeK에서 전시되었다.

title: Unidentified object
desc_src: An incomplete unidentified bone object, which has been cut away on one face around an inverted triangle, which is one side of a central hole. This hole is also apparent on the reverse although the bone to one side is broken and missing. Another inverted triangle appears to be at the other side of the hole. However, this has been caused by breaks and is not a clean cut. It seems likely this has just broken in a fortuitous fashion. There is no bone beyond this. The incomplete object measures 83.21x17.92x11.48mm and weighs 7.19g. The diameter of the hole is 4.21mm. While this may be a fitting or toggle of some kind, it is possible it may be a form of musical instrument, often carved from pig metacarpels and metatarsels (Lawson 1995, Finds Reseacrh Group Datasheet 18, Pig Metapoidal 'Toggles' and Buzz-discs - Traditional Musical Instruments ). These have a central perforation and when threaded and spun, produce a slow, breathy rhythmic humming, rising and falling in pitch with each cycle of rotation, and have been discovered from Early-Medieval, Medieval and Early Post-Medieval contexts.
notes: 뼈로 된 불완전한 고고학 출토 유물 — 정적 유물

description_ko: 18세기 말 프랑스 생폴쉬르위바예에서 제작된 것으로 소개되는 자동인형이다. 흰 드레스와 붉은 테두리 보닛을 쓰고 있다.
detail_text_ko: 원문에 따르면 18세기 말 제작된 자동인형으로, 알프스 지역 생폴쉬르위바예(Saint-Paul-sur-Ubaye) 출신이라고 한다. 그레노블 도피네 박물관(Musée dauphinois)의 장기 전시 '알프스 사람들(Gens de l'alpe)'에 있다. 사진에서는 움직이는 기계 장치가 확인되지 않는다.
notes: 사진에서 기계 장치 확인 불가. 원문 'Automate' 근거로 통과, 애매함. 인종적 고정관념이 담긴 역사적 소재일 수 있어 갤러리 노출 전 사람 검토 권장 [4e 제외: 사람 판단(민감/부적합)]

attribution: Traumrune / Own work / CC BY-SA 3.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: Anamorphe-N
desc_src: Anamorphose conique par V. Sies auteur éditeur, Paris, 1842 (collection particulière). Photos prises lors d’une exposition à la préfecture de Toulouse en septembre 2010 réalisée par les Machines du Fantasmagore

attribution: Beyond My Ken / Own work / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 윌슨 휘얼리그 파크의 바람개비 (Whirligig Park, Wilson 01)
desc_src: The Vollis Simpson Whirliigig Park on Goldsboro Street S. at Douglas Street S. in Wilson, North Carolina, opened on November 2, 2017 to document, conserve, and display the large whirlgigs from Simpson's property in Lucama, North Carolina. Wilson held its first annual Wilson Whirligig Festival in 2004. It was renamed in 2016 to the North Carolina Whirligig Festival, and is usually held the first full weekend of November. The North Carolina legislature named the whirligig the state's official folk art in June 2013.
description_ko: 노스캐롤라이나주 윌슨의 공원에 세워진 대형 바람개비 조각이다. 바람을 받아 회전하며, 사진에는 자전거를 탄 인물과 말 탄 인물 모양의 바람개비가 보인다.
detail_text_ko: 볼리스 심슨 휘얼리그 파크는 2017년 11월 개장했으며, 노스캐롤라이나주 루카마에 있던 심슨의 사유지 바람개비를 기록·보존·전시하기 위해 조성되었다. 노스캐롤라이나 주의회는 2013년 6월 이 바람개비를 주의 공식 민속 예술로 지정했다. 원문에 개별 작품의 제작 연도가 없어 비워 둔다.
notes: 작가명은 공원명과 원문의 'Simpson's property' 기준. 2017은 공원 개장 연도라 제작 연도로 쓰지 않음.

attribution: JanB46 / Own work / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 바람 속의 소녀 (Meisje in de wind)
desc_src: 'Meisje in de wind', kunstwerk van Theo Schreurs op de Wilpsedijk bij Wilp. Geplaatst in 2001 ter gelegenheid van de afronding van de dijkversteviging.
description_ko: 네덜란드 빌프 근처 제방 위에 세워진 인물 조각이다. 바람을 맞으며 몸을 앞으로 기울인 자세를 취하고 있다.
detail_text_ko: 원문은 2001년 제방 보강 공사를 마친 것을 기념해 설치된 작품이라고 설명한다. 제목 '바람 속의 소녀'처럼 바람을 맞는 움직임을 형상화했지만, 구동 장치는 사진에서 확인되지 않는다. 사진은 제방 풀밭 위에 선 인물의 뒷모습을 보여준다.
notes: 움직임은 제목과 자세에서 추정(구동 장치 없음). created_year 2001은 원문의 설치 연도('geplaatst in 2001') 기준.

title: Wetterfahne in Seligenstadt mit einer Madonna
desc_src: weather-vane · names of cities and villages (SELIGENSTADT (Main)) · Object depiction · historical narration · depiction of a saint
notes: 풍향계를 그린 연필 기록 드로잉 — 실물 조각이 아니고 움직임 확인 불가

attribution: Bärwinkel,Klaus / Own work / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: Ausstellungs-Info, Osthaus Museum
desc_src: Ausstellungs-Info vor dem Osthaus Museum Hagen . Beworben mit einem Gemälde von Heinz Mack . Seine Ausstellung „Das Licht in mir“ vom 3. Juni bis 3. Sept. 2023.
notes: 전시 안내 포스터와 건물 전경 — 작품 아님

attribution: Beyond My Ken / Own work / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 윌슨 휘얼리그 파크의 바람개비 (Whirligig Park, Wilson 09)
desc_src: The Vollis Simpson Whirliigig Park on Goldsboro Street S. at Douglas Street S. in Wilson, North Carolina, opened on November 2, 2017 to document, conserve, and display the large whirlgigs from Simpson's property in Lucama, North Carolina. Wilson held its first annual Wilson Whirligig Festival in 2004. It was renamed in 2016 to the North Carolina Whirligig Festival, and is usually held the first full weekend of November. The North Carolina legislature named the whirligig the state's official folk art in June 2013.
description_ko: 노스캐롤라이나주 윌슨의 공원에 있는 바람개비 조각이다. 'CBS' 표지판이 달린 기둥 위에 여러 날개가 바람을 받아 돌아가는 구조다.
detail_text_ko: 이 공원은 2017년 11월 개장했으며, 루카마의 심슨 사유지에 있던 대형 바람개비를 보존·전시한다. 사진 속 바람개비는 기둥에 여러 날개가 달려 있고, 옆에는 별 모양 원형 바람개비가 함께 서 있다. 원문에 제작 연도가 없어 비워 둔다.
notes: 작가명은 공원명과 원문의 'Simpson's property' 기준.

attribution: William Warby from London, England / Traffic Light Tree / CC BY 2.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 트래픽 라이트 트리 (Traffic Light Tree)
desc_src: Pierre Vivant's sculpture, Traffic Light Tree in the Docklands, London
description_ko: 런던 도클랜즈에 있는 피에르 비방의 공공 조각이다. 여러 신호등을 나무 모양으로 엮어 세웠으며, 야간 사진에서 불빛이 켜진 모습이 보인다.
detail_text_ko: 원문은 이 조각이 피에르 비방의 작품이며 런던 도클랜즈에 설치되어 있다고 밝힌다. 사진은 밤에 여러 신호등이 빛나는 모습과 주변 고층 건물을 보여준다. 신호가 순차적으로 바뀌는지는 원문과 사진에서 확인되지 않는다. 원문에 제작 연도가 없어 비워 둔다.
notes: 움직임(신호 순차 변화) 근거 부족, 점등 상태만 확인됨. 중복후보: 1703 (같은 Traffic Light Tree의 주간 사진으로 보임)

title: The Political Weather-Vane
desc_src: In the first panel, Before Election, the Democratic donkey is seen as a weather vane on top of the House of Representatives, facing in the direction of Against Cannon Rules; in the second panel, After Election, the donkey has switched directions and faces the direction of For Cannon Rules, and Speaker-elect Champ Clark peers out a window. The New York Times reported on December 17, 1910 that Speaker-elect Clark had advocated the creation of a committee to select the membership of House committees, rather than past policy, known as Cannon Rules after former Speaker Joseph Cannon, by which the Speaker designated the members of each committee.
notes: 정치 풍자 만화 인쇄물 — 작품 아님

attribution: Patafisik / Own work / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 생폴쉬르위바예의 오토마타 (Automates)
desc_src: Automates, Saint-Paul-sur-Ubaye (Alpes-de-Haute-Provence), fin du XVIIIe siècle. Vitrine des colporteurs. Exposition de longue durée "Gens de l'alpe" au Musée dauphinois, Grenoble.
description_ko: 18세기 말 프랑스 생폴쉬르위바예에서 만들어진 것으로 원문에 적힌 자동인형(오토마타)이다. 행상인 진열장에 전시되어 있다.
detail_text_ko: 원문은 프랑스 그르노블의 도피네 박물관 장기 전시 'Gens de l'alpe'의 행상인 진열장에 놓인 오토마타라고 설명한다. 원문은 제작 시기를 18세기 말로만 적어 제작 연도는 비워 둔다. 사진에는 유리 진열장 안에 옷을 입힌 두 인형이 보이며, 움직이는 장치는 사진에서 확인되지 않는다.
notes: 사진상 구동 장치 미확인, 일반 전시 인형일 가능성 있음. 원문은 'Automates'(오토마타)로 명시.

attribution: Beyond My Ken / Own work / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 윌슨 휘얼리그 파크의 바람개비 (Whirligig Park, Wilson 22)
desc_src: The Vollis Simpson Whirliigig Park on Goldsboro Street S. at Douglas Street S. in Wilson, North Carolina, opened on November 2, 2017 to document, conserve, and display the large whirlgigs from Simpson's property in Lucama, North Carolina. Wilson held its first annual Wilson Whirligig Festival in 2004. It was renamed in 2016 to the North Carolina Whirligig Festival, and is usually held the first full weekend of November. The North Carolina legislature named the whirligig the state's official folk art in June 2013.
description_ko: 노스캐롤라이나주 윌슨의 공원에 여러 대형 바람개비가 함께 설치된 장면이다. 바람을 받아 회전하는 구조다.
detail_text_ko: 사진에는 노란 날개의 바람개비, 빨간색과 흰색 기둥, 비행기 모양 장식이 함께 보인다. 공원은 2017년 11월 개장했으며, 루카마의 심슨 사유지에 있던 바람개비를 보존·전시한다. 원문에 개별 작품의 제작 연도가 없어 비워 둔다.
notes: 작가명은 공원명과 원문의 'Simpson's property' 기준. [4e 중복정리: 1225 와 같은 작품]

attribution: Sachikosky / Own work / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: SachikoHayashiPerform
desc_src: Sachiko Hayashi during a gesture-controlled interactive audio-visual performance using a Myo armband. This work integrates Electromyography (EMG) values into real-time tracking of imagery via Max/Jitter/Msp using a laptop webcam. Photo taken at USF Verftet, Bergen.

attribution: Hnr / own work by the original uploader / CC BY-SA 3.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 댄스 차임 (Tanzglockenspiel)
desc_src: Dance Chime at Botanical Garden Hamburg / Germany - each of the nine bronze squares is a different chime that sounds when stepped on
description_ko: 함부르크 식물원에 있는 사운드 설치물이다. 청동 판 9개를 밟으면 판마다 다른 음이 난다.
detail_text_ko: 원문은 함부르크 식물원에 있는 이 설치물에서 청동 사각형 판 9개가 각각 다른 차임 소리를 낸다고 설명한다. 사진은 격자 모양 바닥 위를 사람들이 밟고 지나가는 모습을 보여준다. 관객의 움직임이 작동 방식이 된다. 원문에 제작 연도가 없어 비워 둔다.

attribution: Hungchaka / Own work / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: Blankenhorn Stammbaum Museum Müllheim Else Geschwister
desc_src: Stammbaum Familie Blankenhorn, Markgräfler Museum Müllheim OG II, von Kunstmaler Strattmann Stuttgart 1908 auf Stein gezeichnet, gedruckt. Ausschnitt Familie Adolphine & Adolph Blankenhorn mit ihren sechs Kindern Else, Robert, Erich, Adolf, Irma und Friedrich Wilhelm Adolf (* zwischen 1873 und 1889)

title: 드러머 소년 기계식 끌차 장난감 (Drummer Boy Mechanical Pull Toy)
desc_src: Drummer boy mechanical pull toy. The toy features a ceramic doll playing cymbals and hitting a drum on a cart pulled by a dog as the toy rolls forward. Title: Drummer Boy Mechanical Pull Toy
description_ko: 끌차가 굴러갈 때 도자기 인형이 심벌즈를 치고 드럼을 두드리는 기계식 끌차 장난감이다. 개 한 마리가 수레를 끈다.
detail_text_ko: 끌차 위에는 붉은 옷을 입은 소년 인형이 큰북을 들고 서 있고, 앞에서 털이 달린 개가 수레를 끈다. 수레를 끌면 바퀴가 구르며 인형이 악기를 두드리는 동작이 이어진다. 원문에 제작 연도와 제작자가 없어 비워 둔다.
notes: 도자기 인형은 원문 'ceramic doll' 기준. 움직임은 원문의 동작 설명에 근거.

attribution: Benjamin Shaw / Own work / CC BY-SA 3.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 싱잉 링잉 트리 (Singing Ringing Tree)
desc_src: Singing Ringing Tree (wind powered sound sculpture in Lancashire, England)
description_ko: 영국 랭커셔의 언덕에 세운 바람으로 소리 내는 사운드 조각이다. 여러 개의 금속 파이프가 나무처럼 솟아 바람이 지나면 소리가 난다.
detail_text_ko: 원문은 이 조각이 랭커셔에 있는 바람 구동 사운드 조각이라고 밝힌다. 사진은 흐린 하늘 아래 금속 파이프가 위로 펼쳐진 모습을 보여준다. 제작자와 제작 연도는 원문에 없어 비워 둔다.
notes: 사진 촬영 연도(2026)는 제작 연도로 쓰지 않음. [4e 중복정리: 1645 와 같은 작품]

attribution: Mushushu / Own work / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: Prayomat Heilandskirche Moabit-2
desc_src: Der Prayomat, auch bekannt als Gebetomat, im Vorraum der Heilandskirche in Berlin-Moabit spielt Tonaufnahmen von Gebeten verschiedenster Religionen in zahlreichen Sprachen ab.

attribution: Oliviaefan / Own work / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 청동 바람 조각 I (Wind Sculpture in Bronze I)
desc_src: Wind Sculpture in Bronze I, Yinka Shonibare CBE, 2022. Skulptur i Prinsessan Estelles Skulpturpark.
description_ko: 바람에 부푼 천의 주름을 청동으로 옮긴 조각이다. 정지된 형태이지만 바람에 펄럭이는 움직임을 표현했다.
detail_text_ko: 원문은 2022년 작품이며 스웨덴 프린세스 에스텔 조각공원에 설치되어 있다고 밝힌다. 보라색과 회색 무늬가 있는 표면이 주름진 천이 바람에 날리는 듯한 형태를 만든다. 사진에서 구동 장치는 확인되지 않는다.

attribution: CaptJayRuffins / Own work / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 새거모어 힐 풍차 (Sagamore Hill Windmill)
desc_src: Home to the 26th President, gentleman farmer Teddy Roodevelt, Sagamore Hill was a working farm in Oyster Bay, NY. Historical Marker for the Sagamore Hill National Historic Site is along Sagamore Hill Road in Cove Neck, New York, which is in the Town of Oyster Bay. Windvanes on windpump.
description_ko: 미국 뉴욕 오이스터베이의 새거모어 힐 농장에 있던 풍차다. 바람을 받아 회전하는 구조다.
detail_text_ko: 원문은 새거모어 힐이 오이스터베이의 작업 농장이었으며 풍차 펌프가 있었다고 설명한다. 사진 속 풍차는 목재 타워 위에 금속 날개가 달려 있고, 위에는 난간이 있는 작업 발판이 보인다. 원문에 제작 연도가 없어 비워 둔다.
notes: 예술 작품보다는 농장 급수용 기능 풍차로 보임. 키네틱 작품 포함 여부 검수 필요. 촬영 연도(2021)는 제작 연도로 쓰지 않음.

attribution: DRNRMRZ / Own work / CC BY 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 단철 풍향계 (Veleta de forja)
desc_src: Ornamental wrought-iron weather vane located at the top of the roof of the San Telmo Modernist Kiosk in Las Palmas de Gran Canaria. The building was designed by architect Rafael Massanet y Faus in 1923. This artistic metalwork element crowns the structure and combines its function of indicating wind direction with a decorative purpose, forming part of the building's architectural ornamentation.
description_ko: 라스팔마스 산텔모 모더니스트 키오스크 지붕 꼭대기에 설치된 단철 풍향계다. 바람 방향을 알려 주는 기능과 장식 기능을 함께 가진다.
detail_text_ko: 원문에 따르면 이 키오스크는 건축가 라파엘 마사네트 이 파우스가 1923년에 설계했다. 풍향계는 건물 장식의 일부로, 사진에는 가로대와 십자형 날개, 구형 장식이 보인다. 사진에서는 회전 장치가 확인되지 않는다.
notes: 풍향계는 바람에 반응하는 구조지만 회전 여부는 사진에서 미확인. 건축 장식 성격이 강해 검수 필요. 원문 연도 1923은 건물 설계 연도.

attribution: Johann H. Addicks - addicks@gmx.net / Self-photographed / GFDL 1.2 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: Moireeffekt zwischen Monitor-LCD und Kamera-CCD DSCF3553
desc_src: Moireeffekt zwischen Monitor-LCD und Kamera-CCD (Dank Verzerrung in der Optik bei jeder Skalierung anderes Moire abhängig vom Skalierer)
notes: 모니터·카메라 간 모아레를 찍은 사진 — 파일 목록 화면, 작품 아님

desc_src: Sparklers with a slow shutter speed of 4 seconds. Taken new years eve 2008 in a public park in Dover Heights, New South Wales. I got my young cousin to stand as still as possible whilst rotating both sparklers in a circular motion
notes: 불꽃 막대 빛 궤적을 찍은 개인 사진 — 설치·조각 작품이 아님

title: 기계식 장난감: 광대가 탄 당나귀 수레 (Toy, mechanical)
desc_src: "mechanical toy, locality- Germany. Clown in donkey cart. Toy works with key and spring winding. Goes forward and in reverse. Length 19cm x height 14.5cm." (col.card) Material- tin, felt, cotton. Colour- donkey is grey, clown is red, yellow, white, black, carriage is multicoloured. Markings- clown has red tin legs with yellow smock (big black buttons) with black hat which has a red cotton tassel on it. Clown sits on a donkey carriage for one, carriage wheels are tin with white trim and feature two clowns holding each others ankles. Rear of carriage has another clown on it (red and blue). Carriage has spring cog mechanism at its base, which has a wind up key at the bottom of the base. A third small support wheel protrudes from the front of the base. The donkey is in harness. All tin with cotton tail, moveable legs and ears. Donkey is in harness. all tin with cotton tail, moveable legs and ears. Donkey is covered in grey felt. Cotton reins. Clown moves only at the waist in an upward and downward movement pulling the donkey either to its hind or fore legs. markings- makers mark- LEHMANN.GERMANY - D.R.PATENT - ENGL.PATENT - 6D.R.G.M. - .BILO GES.GESCH (cat.w-sheet)
description_ko: 독일산 태엽 장난감으로, 광대가 탄 당나귀 수레가 앞으로도 뒤로도 움직인다. 열쇠로 태엽을 감아 구동한다.
detail_text_ko: 원문에 따르면 길이 19cm, 높이 14.5cm이다. 주석, 펠트, 면으로 만들어졌으며 광대는 빨강·노랑·흰색 옷을 입고 있다. 태엽과 열쇠로 작동하는 구조로, 당나귀 수레가 전진과 후진을 한다. 제작 연도는 원문에 없어 비워 둔다.
notes: 독일산은 원문 'locality-Germany' 기준. 제작 연도 미확인으로 null.

title: 르네상스 배 모형 기계장치 (Working model of a Renaissance ship with chimes)
desc_src: I. Hammond " Working model " van een renaissance schip met speelwerk (1999, reproduction) They remind me of lego, but are actually on the reproduction of a renaissance table piece.
description_ko: 르네상스 시대 탁상 장식을 본뜬 배 모형으로, 음악 장치와 황동 인형들이 달려 있다. 기계로 움직이는 작동 모형이다.
detail_text_ko: 원문은 1999년에 제작된 재현품(reproduction)이라고 밝힌다. 음악 장치(speelwerk)가 달린 르네상스 배 모형을 재현한 것이다. 사진에는 황동 인형 여러 개와 톱니바퀴가 보인다. 원문 출처는 Museum Speelklok이다.
notes: 원문 표기 'I. Hammond'를 제작자로 기재. 제작자 동명 여부 확인 필요.

title: Irit Tamari, Escalier (comme si c’était) pour le Paradis -2, Art souterrain 2014, Montréal. (12991936044)
desc_src: Zone : Complexe les ailes Installation L’installation traite de la transformation d’images originales vers une dimension nouvelle. L’artiste utilise des photographies du Complexe les Ailes qu’elle découpe pour recréer des flocons de neiges fait de scènes urbaines. Ces flocons urbains sont suspendus à des fils tendus en structure abstraite créé exactement pour cette raison. Comme si le bâtiment se transformait en neige et que cette structure en fils le tenait pour qu’il ne tombe pas au sol. www.artsouterrain.com/fr/irit-tamari/

title: 틴트 윈드후스 기념비 (Tricht Windhoosmonument)
desc_src: Windhoosmonument te Tricht door Marcus Ravenswaaij. De teks op de sokkel luidt: 'Wat Ik doe, weet gij nu niet, maar gij zult het na dezen verstaan' (Joh. 13:7)
description_ko: 네덜란드 트리히트 마을에 세운 기념비다. 큰 바위 위에 팔을 들어 올린 인물 조각들이 서 있다.
detail_text_ko: 원문은 마르쿠스 라벤스바이가 제작한 윈드후스(돌풍) 기념비라고 밝힌다. 받침대에는 '나중에는 알게 되리라'(요한 13:7)라는 문구가 새겨져 있다고 적혀 있다. 인물 자세에서 바람에 휘말리는 긴장감이 읽히지만, 구동 장치는 없다. 원문에 제작 연도가 없어 비워 둔다.
notes: 움직임은 인물 자세에서 추정(구동 없음). 원문 문구는 표기된 대로 옮김. 촬영 연도(2020)는 제작 연도로 쓰지 않음.

title: 달리는 말 모양 구리 풍향계 (Copper weathervane of a trotting horse)
desc_src: Weathervane, copper trotting horse; United States, late 1800s. Exhibit in National Museum of American History, Washington, DC, USA.
description_ko: 달리는 말 모양의 구리 풍향계이다. 풍향계는 바람 방향에 따라 회전하도록 만든 장치다.
detail_text_ko: 미국에서 19세기 후반에 만들어진 것으로 기록된 풍향계이다. 말 형상이 막대 위에 얹혀 있어 바람을 받으면 방향이 바뀌는 구조다. 현재 미국 국립 역사 박물관에 전시되어 있다.
notes: 회전 여부는 사진으로 확인 불가. 풍향계 기능에 근거해 통과 처리 — 재검토 권장.

title: 비엘 연주 여성 자동인형 (Automate, joueuse de vieille)
desc_src: Automate, joueuse de vieille, Saint-Paul-sur-Ubaye (Alpes-de-Haute-Provence), fin du XVIIIe siècle. Vitrine des colporteurs. Exposition de longue durée "Gens de l'alpe" au Musée dauphinois, Grenoble.
description_ko: 18세기 말 프랑스 알프스 지역에서 만들어진 것으로 기록된 여성 자동인형이다. 손잡이 악기 비엘을 연주하는 모습을 재현한다.
detail_text_ko: 생트폴쉬르위베이(알프스-드-오트프로방스)에서 만들어진 것으로 기록되어 있다. 행상인들의 물품을 모아 둔 진열장에 놓인 전시품이다. 그르노블 도피누아 박물관의 장기 전시 '알프스 사람들(Gens de l'alpe)'에 포함되어 있다.
notes: 구동 방식은 원문에 없음. 사진은 악기를 든 인형 모습 확인.

desc_src: The Vollis Simpson Whirliigig Park on Goldsboro Street S. at Douglas Street S. in Wilson, North Carolina, opened on November 2, 2017 to document, conserve, and display the large whirlgigs from Simpson's property in Lucama, North Carolina. Wilson held its first annual Wilson Whirligig Festival in 2004. It was renamed in 2016 to the North Carolina Whirligig Festival, and is usually held the first full weekend of November. The North Carolina legislature named the whirligig the state's official folk art in June 2013.
description_ko: 노스캐롤라이나주 위슨의 야외 공원에 설치된 대형 휘리그(whirligig) 조형물이다. 바람개비형으로 움직이는 구조다.
detail_text_ko: 2017년 11월 2일 개장한 휘리그 공원은 심슨(Simpson)의 소유지 루카마에 있던 대형 휘리그들을 기록·보존·전시하기 위해 조성되었다. 위슨 휘리그 축제는 2004년 처음 열렸고, 2016년 노스캐롤라이나 휘리그 축제로 이름이 바뀌었다. 2013년 노스캐롤라이나 주의회는 휘리그를 주의 공식 민속 예술로 지정하였다.

desc_src: Zone : Complexe les ailes Installation L’installation traite de la transformation d’images originales vers une dimension nouvelle. L’artiste utilise des photographies du Complexe les Ailes qu’elle découpe pour recréer des flocons de neiges fait de scènes urbaines. Ces flocons urbains sont suspendus à des fils tendus en structure abstraite créé exactement pour cette raison. Comme si le bâtiment se transformait en neige et que cette structure en fils le tenait pour qu’il ne tombe pas au sol. www.artsouterrain.com/fr/irit-tamari/

title: Collectif, Propolis, 2017 (42221186522)
desc_src: Montréal, Place des Arts Propolis est une installation sonore et lumineuse qui s'inspire du fonctionnement collectif des abeilles. Conçue par des étudiants en médias interactifs de l'École des médias de l'UQAM, l'installation se veut interactive et ludique; les utilisateurs devant, pour participer, se mobiliser collectivement afin de créer une substance naturelle aux propriétés dépolluantes qui, une fois le réservoir rempli, déclenchera un éloge lumineux et musical. Le pavillon Président-Kennedy de l'UQAM étant connecté en temps réel à l'évolution de Propopolis. Le projet a pour but de mener à une réflexion sur l'importance du travail des pollinisateurs et de leur impact sur le bien-être de la planète. www.projetpropolis.ca experienceilluminart.com/fr-CA/Projets?projet=5

title: 차임스 (Chimes)
desc_src: Montréal, Place des Arts Conçue par le collectif Blackbox, Chimes est une installation lumineuse composée d'un carillon, d'une trentaine de tubes de lumière et de huit haut-parleurs. L'installation qui s'anime aux moindres vacillements du carillon fait référence au principe de la théorie du chaos; un petit geste sur l'environnement ne pouvant qu'impliquer un effet de plus grande envergure. Il suffit alors d'une rafale de vent ou encore d'une interaction avec le public pour que l'atmosphère du lieu se transforme entièrement faisant émerger des motifs lumineux et sonores de façon aléatoire. experienceilluminart.com/fr-CA/Projets?projet=5 collectifblackbox.com
description_ko: 몬트리올 플라스 데 자르에 설치된 조명·소리 설치 작품이다. 카리용의 떨림에 따라 빛과 소리의 패턴이 움직인다.
detail_text_ko: 콜렉티프 블랙박스가 만든 작품으로 카리용, 약 30개의 조명 튜브, 스피커 8개로 구성된다. 바람이나 관객과의 상호작용이 더해지면 공간의 빛과 소리가 무작위로 바뀐다. 작은 움직임이 큰 변화로 이어진다는 혼돈 이론의 원리를 참조한다.
notes: 중복후보: 1359, 1360, 1361 (같은 설치작의 다른 사진으로 보임)

title: 드럼 치는 곰 자동인형 (Drumming Bear automaton)
desc_src: Exhibit in the Mathematisch-Physikalischer Salon (Zwinger), Dresden, Germany. This artwork is old enough so that it is in the public domain. Photography was permitted in the museum without restriction.
description_ko: 작센에서 만들어진 것으로 추정되는 드럼 치는 곰 자동인형이다. 드레스덴 수학물리 살롱에 전시되어 있다.
detail_text_ko: 원제목에 따르면 1625년경(c.) 작센 제작으로 추정된다. 작센 공 율리우스 하인리히가 선제후 요한 게오르크 1세에게 선물한 것으로 기록되어 있다. 드레스덴 츠빙거의 수학물리 살롱에 전시되어 있다.
notes: 제작 연도는 'c.' 추정치

title: 뒤집힌 세상 자동인형 (Topsy-Turvy World automaton)
desc_src: Exhibit in the Mathematisch-Physikalischer Salon (Zwinger), Dresden, Germany. This artwork is old enough so that it is in the public domain. Photography was permitted in the museum without restriction.
description_ko: 아우크스부르크에서 만들어진 것으로 추정되는 금빛 탑형 자동인형이다. 드레스덴 수학물리 살롱에 전시되어 있다.
detail_text_ko: 원제목에 따르면 1590년경(c.) 아우크스부르크에서 한스 슐로트하임이 만든 것으로 추정된다. 금빛 장식 탑 위에 인형과 동물 조각이 배치되어 있다. 드레스덴 츠빙거의 수학물리 살롱에 전시되어 있다.
notes: 작가·연도는 'probably', 'c.' 추정치

attribution: Johann Jaritz / Own work / CC BY-SA 4.0 / via Wikimedia Commons
title: 빌라 베네치아 풍향계 (Weather vane at Villa Venezia)
desc_src: Weather vane at Villa Venezia, Josef Victor Fuchs 1891, Johannaweg #1, municipality Pörtschach am Wörther See , district Klagenfurt Land, Carinthia , Austria , EU
description_ko: 오스트리아 푀르트샤흐의 빌라 베네치아 지붕에 달린 사자 모양 풍향계이다. 장식 철제 기둥 위에 사자 실루엣이 얹혀 있다.
detail_text_ko: 풍향계는 바람 방향에 따라 회전하도록 만든 장치다. 원문 설명에는 빌라 베네치아와 함께 '요제프 빅토르 푹스, 1891'이 적혀 있다. 빌라 베네치아는 오스트리아 카린티아주 클라겐푸르트란트 지구의 요한나베크 1번지에 있다.
notes: 풍향계를 바람 구동물로 보고 통과. 건축 장식 일부로 볼 여지가 있어 재검토 권장. '1891'과 '푹스'가 제작자·연도인지 원문상 불명확해 null 처리

title: 버티는 노새 기계 장난감 (Lehmann "Balking Mule" Mechanical Toy)
desc_src: "The Balking Mule," lithographed tinplate mechanical toy produced by the Lehmann Company in Germany Title: Lehmann "Balking Mule" Mechanical Toy
description_ko: 독일 레만 사가 만든 석판 인쇄 주석 기계 장난감으로, 노새가 끄는 수레와 마부가 함께 있다.
detail_text_ko: 독일 레만(Lehmann) 사가 석판 인쇄한 주석판으로 만든 기계식 장난감이다. 회색 노새가 수레를 끄는 모습이며 원문은 이를 '버티는 노새(Balking Mule)'라고 소개한다. 구동 방식과 제작 연도는 원문에서 확인되지 않는다.

title: 레만 '카메룬' 기계 장난감 타조 수레 (Lehmann "Kamerun" Mechanical Toy Ostrich Cart)
desc_src: Lithographed tinplate "Kamerun" mail cart pulled by an ostrich produced by the Lehmann Company in Germany. Title: Lehmann "Kamerun" Mechanical Toy Ostrich Cart
description_ko: 타조가 끄는 '카메룬' 우편 수레를 본뜬 석판 인쇄 주석 기계 장난감이다.
detail_text_ko: 독일 레만 사가 만든 주석판 기계 장난감으로, 타조가 끄는 노란 우편 수레에 제복 차림의 인물이 타고 있다. 수레 측면에 '카메룬(KAMERUN)'이라는 글자가 적혀 있다. 구동 방식은 원문에서 확인되지 않는다.

title: 레만 '만다린' 기계 장난감 (Lehmann "Man Da Rin" Mechanical Toy)
desc_src: "Man Da Rin" mechanical toy produced by the Lehmann Company in Germany. The toy features two Chinese men carrying a sedan with a third man inside. Title: Lehmann "Man Da Rin" Mechanical Toy
description_ko: 두 남자가 가마를 메고 가는 장면을 담은 독일 레만 사의 기계 장난감이다.
detail_text_ko: 독일 레만 사가 만든 기계식 장난감으로, 두 남자가 막대에 매달린 가마를 메고 있고 가마 안에 세 번째 인물이 앉아 있다. 가마 측면에 'MAN DA RIN'이라는 글자가 적혀 있다. 구동 방식과 제작 연도는 원문에서 확인되지 않는다.

desc_src: Valotaideteos "Cloud" Annankadulla, kuvattu Annankadun ja Kalevankadun risteyksen suunnasta. Sen tekijät ovat Caitlind r.c. Brown ja Wayne Garrett. Vasemmalla liike Annankatu 24:ssä, taustalla häämöttää Kampin kauppakeskus. Ihmisiä on kerääntynyt katselemaan teosta, joka koostuu valkoisesta pilvimuodosta ja siitä riippuvista ohuista valkoisista langoista. Jotkut valokuvaavat teosta. Se on osa Helsinki Lux -tapahtumaa vuonna 2016 ja Annankatu on tältä osuudeltaan muutettu kävelykaduksi teoksen esilläolon ajaksi.

title: 후린 풍경 (Fuurin)
desc_src: Japanese wind chime fūrin (風鈴) used only during hot humid summers in Japan. The pleasant sound that it makes brings a feeling of coolness and relief.
description_ko: 일본 여름에 쓰는 풍경(風鈴)으로, 바람에 울리는 소리가 더위를 식혀 준다.
detail_text_ko: 일본에서 한여름 무더위에 쓰는 바람 종 후린(風鈴)이다. 유리 구 안에 붉은 물고기와 파도가 그려져 있고, 아래에 '江戸風鈴'이라 적힌 종이 단자쿠가 달려 있다. 원문은 바람에 흔들릴 때 나는 맑은 소리가 청량감을 준다고 설명한다.
photographer: The original uploader was Michalkun at English Wikipedia .

description_ko: 미니애폴리스 노코미스 도서관에서 부모와 아이들이 도널드 셀렌더의 '바람과 물의 차임' 옆에서 책을 읽는 장면이다.

notes: 인물 중심 사진이나 작품이 배경에 뚜렷이 보여 통과 — 확인 필요. 중복후보: 1381, 1382

title: Magic Calculator (51333056644)
desc_src: I never had one of these but my Dad used something very similar when he was a Milkman. I used to help him on his round in Farnham and he had a mechanical calculator like this to add £ s and d for bills. Had a little metal pointer stylus. He then moved on to very early LED calculators. I think the first programmable device I actually used was an Olivetti desk calculator we had at school in the early 70's. They had some similar calculators in the museum. www.computinghistory.org.uk/sec/2934/Electro-Mechanical

detail_text_ko: 작가가 집 뒷마당에서 f/20, 10초 장노출로 촬영한 빛그림 실험이다. 여러 색의 크리스마스 조명을 사용하고 카메라 움직임을 바꿔 색을 그렸다. 이미지에는 빨강과 파랑의 빛이 소용돌이처럼 얽혀 어두운 배경에 퍼져 있다.
